justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/resolution/Solver.java, javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/SymbolSolver.java, javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/JavaParserFacade.java, and javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/TypeExtractor.java. Solver is a small interface with 11 method signatures and no fields or implementation logic; in production code it is only referenced by three classes, and there is a single implementation (`SymbolSolver`) that mostly delegates to `Context` and `TypeSolver`. The repository shows some test fan-in, but not the strong bidirectional dependency concentration expected for hub-like modularization.
